operators.name: l2_normalize_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as input tensor, e.g., [B, C, H, W]

semantics: Computes Lp normalization along the specified dimension dim for each sample.
For each slice along dim, compute norm = (sum(abs(x_i)^p))^(1/p), then divide by max(norm, eps).
In this task p=2.0, dim=1, eps=1e-5.
The input tensor can have arbitrary strides; the kernel must handle non-contiguous tensors correctly.
Output has identical shape to input.

operators.name: conv_transpose2d_forward

parameters.name: weight
parameters.shape: [C_in, C_out // groups, kernel_h, kernel_w] for ConvTranspose2d; in this task [C_in, C_out, 3, 3] with groups=1

parameters.name: stride
parameters.note: Single int for both dimensions; actual stride tuple (stride, stride)

parameters.name: padding
parameters.note: Single int for both dimensions; actual padding tuple (padding, padding)

parameters.name: output_padding
parameters.note: Single int for both dimensions; actual output_padding tuple (output_padding, output_padding)

returns.shape: [N, C_out, H_out, W_out] with H_out = (H_in-1)*stride - 2*padding + kernel_size + output_padding

semantics: The weight tensor shape follows PyTorch ConvTranspose2d: [in_channels, out_channels/groups, kernel_h, kernel_w].
If bias is not None, adds bias to the output after convolution.
The input tensor may have arbitrary strides; but cuDNN requires contiguous tensors, so the launcher will explicitly call .contiguous() on input and weight if needed.
Groups is always 1 in this task.
Stride, padding, output_padding are passed as single ints and applied symmetrically.
The output tensor is allocated as contiguous with the same dtype and device as input.
Computes L2 normalization across channel dimension (dim=1) for each sample and spatial location.
For each vector of length C, v = x[b, :, h, w], compute n = sqrt(sum(v_i^2) + eps), then y[b, c, h, w] = v_c / n.
The input and output tensors have the same shape.
Calls ConvTranspose2d with in_channels=3, out_channels=16, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1, groups=1, bias=True.
Uses cuDNN; output tensor is contiguous.
The final output tensor is returned.
